name: ironfleet-legal
description: NZ legal paralegal for Claude: ingest a matter's documents into a local citation-exact corpus, run the nine-stage multi-agent case pipeline, get court-ready deliverables with verbatim-quote grounding and a full per-run paper trail.

consent_local_processing.title: Matter data processing consent (required)
consent_local_processing.description: IronFleet keeps your matter corpus, records and deliverables on THIS machine (local store, local Ollama embeddings — nothing egresses from the plugin's own code). Matter text you share in conversation enters your Claude account's context: prefer a Team/Enterprise plan with model training OFF for privileged work.
